headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing 0 earned runs.

Several teams suffered injuries, impacting their rosters. The Colorado Rockies placed Mickey Moniak on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis. The San Francisco Giants placed Jung Hoo Lee on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 19, 2026, with a mid-back strain. Other teams with injured players include the Detroit Tigers, Cincinnati Reds, Los Angeles Angels, Chicago Cubs, and St. Louis Cardinals.

The Miami Marlins acquired outfielder Rece Hinds in a trade with the Cincinnati Reds, while the Los Angeles Dodgers acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Chicago White Sox acquired third baseman Oliver Dunn from the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for left-handed pitcher Joe Rock.

top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Shut Down Phillies in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of shutout baseball. Kyle Manzardo led the Guardians' offense with a solo home run in the game.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Yankees 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-2, securing their win. Kevin Gausman earned the win for the Blue Jays, while Louis Varland recorded the save.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Mickey Moniak on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Mickey Moniak has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis.

top_news.title: **Marlins Acquire Hinds in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins have acquired outfielder Rece Hinds in a trade with the Cincinnati Reds. Hinds joins the Marlins in exchange for right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley.
